answer: Use beacon-anchored heartbeat standing. Every identity must publish proof of useful work at beacon-chosen unpredictable times: like water through a narrow inlet, only one heartbeat per identity fits each window. Each heartbeat needs co-signatures from two strangers drawn at random just before, and co-signers lose standing if the work later proves fake. A sybil operator cannot pre-arrange alibis: many identities mean many surprise calls, each needing fresh work and fresh strangers. Standing grows like marble polished over years, on a basalt base of verified history no copy can fake.
